conf.description: F5 BIG-IP ASM attack/anomaly event log, Splunk Key-Value profile: named-field KV extract, no Label indirection needed; carries current_mitigation and violation_counter which the CEF form does not surface

conf.comment: F5 BIG-IP ASM attack/anomaly event log, Splunk Key-Value profile. Named keys throughout, so this skips the CEF route's hardest step (resolving cn3/cs4/cn1/cn2/cs5 through paired *Label fields). attack_id is kept as a keyword, not cast to a number, because 64-bit unsigned values exceed a signed long - the same reason the CEF route keeps f5_bigip.log.attack.id a string.

functions.description: why this pipeline is shaped this way
Message body: a Cribl Syslog Source leaves the full line, header included, in _raw and the body in message; anything else carries the body in _raw.
Extract the space-separated key="value" pairs the anomaly-event Key-Value logging format emits
batch rename every status:mapped field with no transform
implement every partial/unmapped transform: attack_id kept as a keyword (64-bit unsigned overflows a signed long), then drop intermediate parse artifacts
date_time is BIG-IP local time with no zone/offset (per-device tz unresolved - recorded as a gap); write to _time per platform constraint 1, never @timestamp
tag the dataset, hyphen-free per platform constraint 5
Re-nest flat dotted keys (data-maps canonical step)
